title: Binary representation and width equation
statement: Let $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and let $w,s$ be Boolean words with $|s|\le |w|$. The binary digit words of $f(|s|)$ and of the length of the suffix of $w$ after its first $|s|$ entries are equal if and only if $|s|+f(|s|)=|w|$.
replaced:
For a candidate $s$ with $\abs{s} \le \abs{w}$, the binary representation of
$f(\abs{s})$ equals the binary representation of the length of the suffix of
$w$ after position $\abs{s}$ if and only if $\abs{s} + f(\abs{s}) = \abs{w}$;
this includes the case of two empty words.
